name: Book of the Ancients
summary: Azore Aldamort of the Ethel Rethor tower trusts you with a gem. Set in the hand of a serpent statue on Ranazjar Isle, northwest of the tower, it calls up the protector of the Book of the Ancients, which holds secrets the naga have kept for centuries.

sections.title: The Serpent Statue
sections.body: After Sceptre of Light, Azore Aldamort hands you the Gem of the Serpent. A Serpent Statue stands on Ranazjar Isle, a little island to the northwest of the Ethel Rethor tower, and the gem belongs on its hand. That will bring forth the guardian of the Book of the Ancients, a book that holds naga secrets kept for centuries. Azore hopes it will teach much about their scaled foes.

aliases: who gives book of the ancients
faq.answer: The keeper of the tower at Ethel Rethor, who hopes to learn much about the naga, whom Azore calls scaled foes.

faq.q: What is the Book of the Ancients?
aliases: what is the book of the ancients
faq.answer: A book containing the secrets of the naga, kept for centuries. Someone guards it.

aliases: where do i go with the gem
faq.answer: A small island northwest of the Ethel Rethor tower.

faq.q: What is the Gem of the Serpent for?
faq.answer: Set on the hand of the Serpent Statue on Ranazjar Isle, it brings forth the guardian of the Book of the Ancients.
Sceptre of Light, which comes before this step.
